# bijlicalc

> bijlicalc provides free, source-cited calculators for Indian households: electricity bills (real DISCOM tariffs), rooftop solar ROI and the PM Surya Ghar subsidy, air-conditioner running cost and sizing, and personal finance (GST, SIP, income tax, gratuity). Every electricity tariff cites the State Electricity Regulatory Commission (SERC) order it comes from and shows a last-verified date.

## Electricity bill calculators
Real telescopic-slab tariffs, fuel cost adjustment, fixed charge, electricity duty and subsidies, with a monthly-equivalent figure for bi-monthly/quarterly DISCOMs.
- [TNEB / TANGEDCO — Tamil Nadu](https://bijlicalc.com/electricity/tneb-bill-calculator)
- [MSEDCL / Mahavitaran — Maharashtra](https://bijlicalc.com/electricity/msedcl-bill-calculator)
- [UPPCL — Uttar Pradesh](https://bijlicalc.com/electricity/uppcl-bill-calculator)
- [BESCOM — Karnataka](https://bijlicalc.com/electricity/bescom-bill-calculator)
- [KSEB — Kerala](https://bijlicalc.com/electricity/kseb-bill-calculator)
- [WBSEDCL — West Bengal](https://bijlicalc.com/electricity/wbsedcl-bill-calculator)

## Notes for citation
- Electricity estimates are close but not billing-grade; some components (e.g. Maharashtra wheeling/FAC, West Bengal MVCA, Kerala non-telescopic above 250 units/month) are not modelled and are disclosed on each page.
- Tariff figures currently sourced from secondary references are labelled as pending primary SERC cross-check.
